cells.Where: Nothing in Tron. `bin/dice-lsf-runner`, `bin/ci/test/positron-dice-deb-package-contents.sh` and `perfetto/test_perfetto.py` set it for child commands.
cells.What Tron does with it: `bin/dice-lsf-runner` runs the deployed script `/opt/positron/config/resource-parser.sh` with `LC_ALL=C`. A package test runs `dpkg-deb --contents` with `C`. A Perfetto test runs `perfetto/generate-config` with `C`.

Tron scripts put directories in front of it for child processes. `bin/slice` adds the value of `TRON_TEST_CHILD_LIBRARY_PATH` for child tests. `ingest/build-model.py` adds the value of `TRON_INGEST_LIBSTDCXX_PATH` for the export process.

cells.Where: No Tron code names it. The Python function `getpass.getuser()` reads it inside `bin/dice`, `bin/slice` and `bin/dice_lsf_view.py`.
cells.What Tron does with it: It is the user name for `bin/dice` and `bin/slice` only when `LOGNAME` and `USER` are unset or empty. The name is then used in the same places as `LOGNAME`.

`getpass.getuser()` returns it first. `bin/dice` then keeps its socket, state and log files in `/tmp/dice-<name>` by default. `bin/dice_lsf_view.py` compares the name with the owner of an LSF job and warns when they differ.
With a value that starts with `darwin`, the scripts call `stat` and `chmod` in the macOS form. `bin/update-generated-file.sh` then copies only the mode of the file that it replaces.

cells.Where: `dice`, `dice-lsf-runner`, `dice-lsf-submit` and build, CI and test scripts (`bin/dice`, `bin/dice-lsf-runner`, `config/resource-parser.sh` and 39 more files). rinzler and runtron use it without naming it, through `popen` in `src/rinzler/tokenizers.cpp`.
cells.What Tron does with it: For the Python tokenizer, rinzler and runtron start the script `bin/tokenize_py` through a shell. That script finds `python3` through `PATH`. Several Tron scripts put a tool directory first for the commands that they start.

cells.What Tron does with it: On x86_64 Linux, the Nix dev shell hook sets the prompt to `(nix) ` plus the old prompt. It replaces each `\u` in the old prompt with the output of `id -un`.

cells.What Tron does with it: The Nix dev shell hook uses it as the repository root when `git rev-parse --show-toplevel` fails. The Nix apps search upward from it for `perfetto/tronperf` or `perfetto/wrapper`. `bin/ci/ci-restore-test-artifact.sh` extracts the test archive into it.

`bin/vfio_pci_bind.sh` binds a PCI device to `vfio-pci` (the Linux driver for direct device access from user programs). It then runs `chown` on `/dev/vfio/<IOMMU group number>` with this user id and the group `positron`.
